done_when: docs/specs/one-message-one-turn.md says a batch is consumed in receive order and shown by platform time then receive order, matching the owner's 2026-09-29 choice

findings.body: The new presentation rule conflicts with AC1 in this same file at line 57, which still requires the turn to contain all messages “in receive order.” For a photo saved after its later question, the Behaviour section requires photo-first presentation while AC1 still requires question-first order. Update AC1 to distinguish consumption in receive order from presentation by platform time, then receive number, so the acceptance criterion no longer preserves the behavior this fix addresses.
